# Company API Documentation

> Documentation for Company API

## Guides: ADVANCED GUIDES
- [Rate Limiting in API v2](https://pennylane.readme.io/docs/rate-limiting-1.md)

## API Reference: Accounting
- [Retrieve a journal](https://pennylane.readme.io/reference/getjournal.md): Retrieve a journal  > ℹ️ > This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `journals:readonly`, `journals:all`
- [Create a journal](https://pennylane.readme.io/reference/postjournals.md): Create a journal  > ℹ️ > This endpoint requires the following scope: `journals:all`
- [Upload a file](https://pennylane.readme.io/reference/postledgerattachments.md): Upload a file to attach to a ledger entry.  > ‼️ > This endpoint is **DEPRECATED**

## API Reference: Company V2
- [Retrieve a journal](https://pennylane.readme.io/reference/getjournal.md): The same page linked from a second section
